title: Editor crashes on startup on old CPU with no SSE4.2 support
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.5.1 stable, 4.5 stable
Not reproducible in: 4.4.1 stable


### System information

Linux mint 22.2 - Dedicated ATI mobility radeon HD3470 - intel core 2 duo P8400

### Issue description

Godot shows the initial splashscreen, then goes away.


Happens on old PC running ATI Radeon card and fresh install of Linux Mint 22.2 xfce
Sony VAIO VGN-FW11E

Happens both with Flatpak installation and with portable version.
